verdict.rationale: Dover documents e-signed offers, but the evidence pack shows no HRIS or payroll integration that carries a new hire's data into onboarding. The generic API, webhooks, and CSV export are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a signed offer flows into onboarding — HRIS and payroll integrations carry the new hire's data over without re-entry
